newsitem.title: USA: Excel's Ottumwa, Iowa, pork plant closed next week.
newsitem.headline: Excel's Ottumwa, Iowa, pork plant closed next week.

text.p: Excel Corp's fire-damaged Ottumwa, Iowa, hog and pork plant will be closed next week, and demolition work has begun at the plant's damaged loading facility, said Mark Klein, Excel spokesman.
"We will be down next week," said Klein, who also said no reopening date has been set.
An official cause of the Sunday explosion and fire has not been determined, but company and fire officials said it an ammonia leak is the suspected cause.
The fire smoldered for days in the dock's roof, but has been extinguished. By late Friday company crews were working to repair broken water lines and restore electrical power.
The plant's pork production has been shifted to Excel plants at Beardstown, Ill., and Marshall, Mo. Klein said both plants are working additional hours to accomodate the extra production.
The Ottumwa plant can slaughter 9,600 hogs a day, but is being expanded to slaughter 15,000 head daily.
